method: Agent visually inspected all 69 generations, selected edits, category sheets and actual GPU captures; no OCR or user art approval claimed.

corrections.spray_demolish: Regenerated on magenta after native alpha lost lettering.
corrections.sign_stationery_faded: ImageGen edit retains the original red subtitle.
corrections.plate_no_flyers: ImageGen edit removes unwanted final period.
corrections.sign_v_inn_broken: ImageGen edit moves the missing 인 to the fourth syllable slot.
corrections.aframe_snack: ImageGen edit places middle-dot separators after prices.

observations: Large shop titles, demolition paint and banners remain legible at native 1.75x framing. Small body text and number plates are texture detail at this scale.
Generated mechanical recess uses an independent full gear texture under a separate stone-aperture shader; it is static, with an angle parameter reserved for later animation.
No real storefront photographs were supplied to generation. Blank pseudo-text areas, invented shop names and requested fictional numbers were used.
Source board dimensions have the explicitly listed deviations; the runtime dimensions are verified. Minor material-relief shading remains in generated albedo.
Reusable catalog includes six unused horizontal sign variants and any poster not selected by this map seed. Not every catalog image is placed in this single trial map.
